description: Post-lowering AST conformance for grids/latlon/rules/central_D2_lat_zero_grad_bc — centered second derivative (per-degree diffusion) with ghost-elimination zero-gradient pole rows on the latlon grid. Every binding loads fixture.esm (NLON=8, NLAT=5 bound at the import edge), runs the section-9.6.3 rewrite fixpoint, and must emit a byte-identical expanded AST for the model: the compound D(D(u,lat),lat) replaced by the rule's two-axis makearray (interior 3-point second-difference stencil over [1,8] x [2,4]; full-rank ghost-eliminated one-sided aggregates at the j=1 and j=5 pole rows), zero apply_expression_template nodes, zero unlowered rewrite-target ops, zero surviving metaparameter names, and the consumer-supplied spacing surviving as the free name dlat_deg. The golden is generated by the Julia reference runner only (scripts/regenerate-goldens.sh) and compared bytewise by the other bindings.
